from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class DocumentJudgmentInfo(BaseModel):
    """Extracted facts from a single judgment document needed to match it to the provided judgment result options."""
    case_type: str | None = Field(description="The legal case type and instance level, e.g., '行政二审', '民事二审', '刑事二审', '再审审查'")
    appellant_names: list[str] = Field(description="Names of the appellants/petitioners challenging the decision, as listed in the document")
    respondent_names: list[str] = Field(description="Names of the respondents/appellees, as listed in the document")
    primary_outcome: str | None = Field(description="The core court ruling summary, e.g., '驳回上诉，维持原判', '撤销裁定', '驳回再审申请'")
    case_number: str | None = Field(description="The case number referenced in the document, if any")
    court_costs: str | None = Field(description="Details regarding court fees, including amount and who bears them, e.g., '二审案件受理费 50 元，由上诉人马某海负担'")
    sentence_details: str | None = Field(description="Specific sentencing details for criminal cases, e.g., '判处有期徒刑一年，并处罚金人民币二十万元'")
    retrial_decision: str | None = Field(description="Decision on retrial application if applicable, e.g., '驳回再审申请'")
    quote: str = Field(description="A short verbatim excerpt anchoring the extracted facts")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    document_judgments: list[DocumentJudgmentInfo]
